Mouth plate: cardboard or plastic giving the mouth its snap
Key vocabulary: Muppet-style — the foam-and-fleece hand-and-rod technique; Shadow puppet — figures cast on a screen.
Governing principle: The performance sells the puppet, not the construction.
how_it_works: The Signature learner approaches Current Research Frontiers in Puppet Making by anchoring it to what is already known: Muppet-style (the foam-and-fleece hand-and-rod technique), then Shadow puppet (figures cast on a screen). The working method is Foam method: sketch the head, carve foam slightly large, cover with fleece, set eyes and mouth plate Practice means rehearsing the idea until it can be reconstructed from scratch, which is exactly what the accompanying study program drills.
requirements: Reader needs no prior background: every term used here is defined in this entry or in the Foundations tier entries before it.
standards: Standard curricula, textbooks, and professional references for puppet making.

overview: In the Signature teaching of puppet making, The Future of Puppet Making is a load-bearing idea: understand it and much of the field clicks into place. The Signature presentation stresses why each principle holds, shows where it is used in real practice, and connects it forward to the Advanced material that follows.
